assumptions: Personnel-task reconciliation uses only local action receipts or delivered reports: at an action boundary, a redundant T033 whose person is already acknowledged, or a T031 whose person is already treated, is canceled as stale through A054, preserving costs without a new load, treatment or success credit. A T033 whose on-carrier goal is already locally evidenced may close through its existing goal check. A payload rejection does not permanently blacklist the carrier; current payload and commitment filters still apply, including the real occupied load until confirmed handover. No capability, capacity, receiver or access restriction is relaxed.

Shared camera allocation/contact policy (authored, uncalibrated; not catalog urgency): all scenes use T002=70, T014=70 (80 for locally believed major/destroyed damage), and established-human T027=78. A single-frame camera-candidate T027 stays <=64; person/human detections of the same locally associated candidate in >=2 distinct capture parent /image IDs from the same reporting agent promote its T027 to 81, above those surveys at a safe boundary. Raw/associated copies, duplicate boxes and replays of the same capture count once. An existing waiting proposed T027 is refreshed in-place once on promotion, without a new A050 or revision; timestamps and frame IDs are not proposal-signature changes. Camera-review T011 stays <=63. Failed candidate A009 sensor contacts suppress the same candidate or a locally recorded site within 3 m for 120 s and require camera presence evidence acquired after the failure before retry; failure does not establish human absence. These are shared defaults even without camera_search_policy; explicit existing overrides are honored, and regional search policies are unchanged. Existing commitments use authored policy fields F202/F209/F212 from 10_字段385; 05_任务96 and 14_场景任务映射 do not mandate task ordering. A coordinator-known accepted/executing commitment with a matching delivered current-task id/revision remains an allocator candidate, subject to priority, interruptibility, capability, access, payload and energy checks. Queued A052 and assignments awaiting delivery/acceptance remain reserved; unmatched current-task reports do not release them. A053 acceptance-to-deadline windows are not unconditional uninterruptible leases: replacement acceptance still waits for the real action boundary and A056 checkpoint, with A057 revalidation on resume. Equal-priority 81 contacts cannot interrupt each other. A queued camera T027 is canceled as stale through A054 only when its exact local candidate has a delivered belief.entity_ref and the referenced human needs are known without a contact need. Recheck before allocation/acceptance and before initial approach/A009, not after this task own successful contact; no distance-only identity or suppression of unassociated tracks. A059 services may preempt only a lower-priority executing preemptible ordinary commitment through the existing A053/A056 action-boundary checkpoint and A057 resume; active service scopes and real capability/access/energy/aboard constraints remain binding. Service A053 rechecks local commitments, and refusals retain busy/payload/access/energy/tool causes instead of all becoming capability failures. Fresh unassociated tracks can still starve lower-priority searches under this unchanged policy. No scene switch, truth, count, location, outcome or capability change is introduced. Survey-relative starvation is expected to be removed only when corroboration and real capability, access, energy and delivery permit; contact, rescue and fixed-horizon results are not guaranteed.

Camera re-sightings of an already contacted person (a local non-camera human with delivered contact needs) associate to that person when strict point-in-box and camera-track matches miss, using the same measured box tests: its contact foot point projected inside the box, else within the measured bottom-edge half-span around the box bottom-centre ground estimate. One-person-per-frame exclusion still applies. This prevents repeat contacts of the same known resident from minting new tracks; it never marks an uncontacted or unknown person absent and changes no truth, needs, urgency or capability.

A carrier with an unacknowledged person aboard does not accept (A053) or resume (A057) unrelated work such as contact, survey or clearance until that person is handed over; care, load, transport, handover and water-recovery tasks (T029-T036) still proceed. This applies the existing A059 service rule ("a team with a person aboard finishes that person's handover before serving anyone else") to ordinary tasks. A deferred commitment stays suspended, not failed; capacity, access, receiver and truth checks are unchanged.

The source pedestrian graph explicitly joins R01--A01--P01 and A01--P02 across the existing graded assembly pad. These source-authorized pad traversals are logical foot/legged navigation edges at adjacent trail width, not new terrain, arbitrary road-gap bridges or wheeled access; original source-road blockers remain binding.

Mission authoring uses the existing legacy placement interfaces and preserves the entire upstream geometry/catalog source. Original source regions/reservations, class names, damage states, allocated assets and their delivery gaps are unchanged.

Seed controls sampled authored placements/headings only. Canonical/source physical surfaces remain the support and height authority at unit GLB scale. Whole footprints must satisfy the actual source polygon and classes; region bounding boxes are not replacement geometry.

Humans are private placed_humans/pinned_humans truth, never public brief, prior, navigation_goals or camera-focus hints. Search, contact and rescue require actual local observations/messages; no person identities, counts, poses, needs or coordinates are exposed through public guidance.

Only delivered HUM-001-C01-BASE using assets/glb/HUM-001-C01-BASE_static.glb may display any person, including the team stand-in. Injury/mobility are authored task truth, not a geometric pose claim. display.human_asset_policy=delivered_base_only must also prevent automatic production prone/supine substitution.

UAV uses the existing SC01 camera observation interface/settings inherited from the upstream config; no new perception backend or truth-reading sensor is introduced. Parent propagates shared camera configuration.

The robot dog has only existing RGB/range, contact, planning, compute/network/evidence and task-management interfaces. No C16/C17 manipulation, C22 human carriage, C24 cargo loading or C26 unloading is granted; T030/T038/T040 cargo tasks are excluded even for the cargo-dog mesh.

The existing foot-mobile specialist_team supplies C21 professional assessment/aid and C22 human carrying with inherited 120 kg payload, speed and access limits; each target has authored mass 75 kg. No heavy engineering, lifting, rope, water, RF or environmental equipment is invented. A group cannot be loaded together above that rating.

medical-1 is a real finite-capacity authored staffed receiving station in an existing reservation, displayed by the existing small shelter. It is not an unbound allocated medical shell, a new road or an off-scene hospital. A022 must obtain actual receiver confirmation and release carrying occupancy; arrival alone is not final handover.

Finite medical_pack stock at the receiver allows actual post-arrival professional treatment if needed, not remote aid or automatic healing. All agents retain actual capability/resource/action gates and unsuccessful or unfinished objectives remain visible.

The inherited allocated_field_operation incident_binding runtime gate is removed. Its original value is retained only in provenance.original_incident_binding as historical source metadata; authored mission humans are not gated by selection of an allocated platform or prop.
No simulation or layout generation has been run for this config; placement feasibility, reachability and rescue completion are not claimed.

SC10 represents the mountain/forest missing-search category associated with ESAR Aotai; this synthetic source layout is not a reconstruction or benchmark reproduction. Preserve canopy occlusion, source terrain, the 1.5 m legged/foot trails, 1.2 m foot-only crest route and compact-vehicle-only R01. No wheeled ambulance is sent to the camp/crest.

The five actually allocated undelivered P-SIT person rows become five private authored 75 kg limited-mobility missing targets in the real RESV_C01 camp PAD. Each is explicitly substituted by delivered BASE; no sitting geometry, allocated demographic identity or missing-pose coverage is claimed. RESV_A01 assembly PAD contains the finite capacity-five shelter receiver and foot carrier deployment.

The imported dog currently starts near RESV_C01 on its real source support and may detect targets locally early; that is retained source deployment, not public target knowledge. One 120 kg foot carrier must handle the five targets serially, and incomplete searches/transports within 3600 s remain incomplete.

No extra UAV/dog planning or coordinate-alignment capability is invented: remove C14 from UAV and C14/C40 from dog; UAV C40 is inherited from its native embodiment. Native missing capability checks remain binding even when a task is listed as a candidate; unresolved branches are a capability gap, not a successful search or motion.
